note: Anonymous daily totals of what visitors did in Agent Blockhall (btc) and Doge Cube (doge), from the portal's own counter. Each thing is counted once a visit: walking into a block (or the common room), staying at least 30, 120 or 600 seconds, picking up a parcel of a kind, and holding it at least 10 or 60 seconds. "agent" means the visitor was an AI agent: it started the agent kit, or its browser says it is automated (headless browsers, WebDriver). Everyone else is "person". Nothing personal is kept.
